source_title: Game Theory #12: The Law of Eschatological Convergence
summary: This March 12, 2026 classroom source gives a live Iran-war formulation of eschatological convergence: sacred scripts become predictive by overlapping on Al-Aqsa, Third Temple, Pax Judaica, Antichrist-as-system, draft/civil-war, Gulf money, and Hormuz pressure, but the forecast branches must stay split before any public page or ledger promotion.

new_lens_seeds.title: Law Of Eschatological Convergence
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Compare rival end-times scripts, identify their overlapping crisis objects, and treat those convergence points as predictive pressure because different actors can move toward the same event for incompatible sacred reasons.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could route future Al-Aqsa, Third Temple, Pax Judaica, Antichrist, Gog and Magog, Iran, Russia, Catholic, Orthodox, and Christian Zionist material, but the current Eschatology parent already carries the mechanism without needing a child page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a routing seed only. Recent Eschatology split reviews kept the parent whole and said any child must be child-specific, not a topic page from broad convergence pressure.

new_lens_seeds.title: Antichrist As System
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A personified apocalyptic enemy becomes an administrative order: one-world government, AI surveillance, digital ID, digital currency, and population permission surfaces carry the role that older scripts gave to the Antichrist.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism helps compare Eschatology, AI Control, Mass Society, and Prediction, but current evidence is better routed through existing Holy Empire / AI-control and digital-permission surfaces.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone Antichrist, Mark Of The Beast, Digital ID, AI Surveillance Empire, or One-World Government pages from this source alone.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-03-12, this is an earlier classroom formulation of the Iran-war Al-Aqsa falsifier later restated in the April 3 Hasan hostile-audit interview; later comparison should preserve the March 12 source date.
The source gives a two-to-four-year horizon for the convergence map, then lists several forecast branches; those branches must be split into discrete Prediction records before scoring.

The final student objection clarifies the method: Jiang can accept an accidental or political trigger while still arguing the same outcome pattern follows once war, Gulf fragility, Hormuz leverage, finance dependence, and sacred scripts overlap.
